description: This file defines an enumeration class 'ConflictResolution' which specifies different strategies for resolving conflicts in data synchronization or processing within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: ConflictResolution
classes.description: Enumeration class representing conflict resolution mechanisms with three possible strategies.

methods.name: ConflictResolution::TIMESTAMP
methods.description: Conflict resolution strategy based on timestamp comparison.

methods.name: ConflictResolution::EXTERNAL_BASED
methods.description: Conflict resolution strategy based on external source data.

methods.name: ConflictResolution::INTERNAL_BASED
methods.description: Conflict resolution strategy based on internal source data.
